capabilities: Browse types and folders in a sidebar navigator
Generate type pages and folder boards backed by Bases
Show daily notes and tasks in a calendar
Provide a Home dashboard and new-tab search panel
disambiguation: Not a text-folding or typing tool: it registers folders as object types and builds navigation, pages and boards around them.
extras: Weather in the Home greeting is off by default and requests open-meteo.com only; no other network requests or telemetry. The plugin hooks into Obsidian internals for embedded Bases tabs, File explorer reveal and the New tab command, all undone when disabled. A demo vault is included.
motivation: The author wanted Obsidian to work like object-based note apps, where a folder of notes becomes a type.
problem: Notes in Obsidian have no type beyond frontmatter, so a folder of similar notes gets no shared page, board or navigation of its own.

relations.evidence: Notion-style Board / List / Feed views for type pages and boards (otherwise core Table and Cards are used)
With Folder notes, clicking a folder opens its folder note with a board of that folder's notes.
TaskNotes — one note per task; add them in natural language
Tasks — the checkbox tasks the Tasks plugin tracks, with its global filter
a Notion-like search panel in every new tab

summary: Plugin that turns folders into object types, adding a sidebar navigator, type pages with Bases boards, a Home dashboard and a new-tab search panel.
